statement: Passed sections mean evidence and limited checks are complete for independent model delivery, not measured architectural accuracy or HTML acceptance.

source_photos.scope: Four actually viewed licensed Commons previews retained at exact bytes, with four separate authors/licenses; none embedded as texture.

identity_footprint.scope: Single named OSM w47011877@11 / GERS66c3a80d owner, original source octagon and anchor retained. This does not prove owner boundary is the visible wall/eave line.

height_evidence.scope: 40.64m total/32.3m body follows the cited official nominal convention. No survey, common ground datum, measured storey height or verified photo metric claim.

visible_facade_opening_grid.scope: Real seven-level shell openings and alternating blind panels; decoded wall rays and limited actual native review passed. First-level cardinal opening phase remains unverified scenario0.

roof.scope: Seven continuous curved eaves and distinct gallery brackets, tiles/rafters/finial; actual exported finite tile samples plus native visual review. Not whole-assembly intersection freedom or measured roof curvature. The 56 new solid grey ridge seats pass finite actual triangle contact checks against unchanged roof and ridges; decorative t>1 tips may cantilever.

texture_mapping_qa.scope: Intentional zero images/textures in raw/web/LOD; color materials and geometric details, without baked photograph lighting.

geometry_proof.scope: Actual exported Float32 part closure/normals/volume, exact decoded web oriented position/material triangle multiset and <=0.05deg normal rule; finite door/roof checks. Does not certify unseen interiors. All17983 previous v2 parts retain exact oriented POSITION/NORMAL and materials; only56 additional ridge-seat parts are present. This remains finite contact evidence, not whole-model collision freedom.

size_proof.scope: All four actual package assets individually strictly less than100,000,000 bytes; no native size inferred before generation.

uncertainty.scope: Nominal height, estimated widths/taper/depths/roof curve, unknown absolute door phase, hidden faces, repair epochs and viewing-navigation scope remain explicit.
